# scrcpy-server

`scrcpy-server-v5.0.1` is the server of [scrcpy](https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy) v5.0.1
by Genymobile and Romain Vimont, unchanged, under the Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`).
Aoi pushes it to an Android phone and starts it there to receive the phone's screen as
H.264 from its hardware encoder (`src/android.rs`).
